title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, face, chest burst, zigzags, legs, feet, BB)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v3: wings and an angular beak
notes: v3 (you asked for more wing-like arms and a more angular beak). Wings: each arm is now a flat wing blade hanging from the shoulder, angled out at the bottom and swept back, ending in three flat primary feathers (front shortest, back longest) with the white zigzag across the feather ends. The thinnest feather tips are about 1.3 mm. Beak: rebuilt from flat faces instead of blobs. A ridge runs down the top with faces sloping off both sides, the upper beak ends in a sharp downward hook, and the lower beak is a wedge underneath, with the mouth slightly open. Everything else is as in v2. Check: do the wings read well from the front, or should they stand out further from the body? Is the beak angular enough, or too blocky?
